correctness.rationale: Exact q²+beta x²+gamma x identity; sharpness from evaluating its two opposite-sign q-roots when beta<0. Direct G derivative proves absence of periodic motion for nonzero alpha; if alpha=0 ordinary energy excludes periodic motion. Proper W=energy-y phi(x), phi′=(1+x²)^-3, has negative orbital derivative off a compact because -xF leads -x6, phi′ F² grows only x4, and -phi′ y² controls large y at bounded x. This gives complete bounded forward trajectories; unique hyperbolic sink plus PB gives convergence. Rational checker reproduces a finite sample, not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The closest prior Proposition 7.3 is a conditional sign criterion; its Corollary 7.6 gives restrictive sufficient discriminant conditions, notably V=8a3-3a4²>0, not an exact elimination of the affine parameter. The proposed exact if-and-only-if certificate-feasibility boundary and global attraction across it are absent from the accessible full source, and the concrete a3=-1 counterexample lies outside that corollary. General prior cyclicity/perturbation literature has no verified covering statement. Residual risk: classical quartic positivity optimization might be published under different notation; full texts of certain background sources were unavailable.

value.rationale: Determines the full sharp coefficient region for a natural affine Dulac/monotonicity certificate associated with the widely studied quintic Liénard system, rather than a further arbitrary sufficient slice. The resulting a2-uniform GAS theorem applies when xF<0 on open intervals and the elementary quadratic energy fails as a Lyapunov function (a1=1,a2=5,a3=-1,a4=0), and substantially enlarges the motivating corollary. This is a natural complete methodological classification with a dynamical consequence, not a claim of a new general no-cycle mechanism.
